fields.quote: مسقط في 29 أغسطس 2026 /العُمانية/ تنطلق غدًا الأحد منافسات الجولة الأولى من دوري جندال لكرة القدم للموسم الرياضي 2026/2027، بإقامة 3 مباريات
fields.note: OM1L is the Oman Professional League, now the Jindal League. No 2026-27 season article exists on English or Arabic Wikipedia (the latest is 2024-25, the asset's proxy), so this comes from the state news agency's round-1 report dated 29 August 2026 ('tomorrow, Sunday' = 30 August 2026); a match-schedule roundup states the same day outright ('انطلق دوري جندال ... يوم الأحد 30 أغسطس 2026') and puts round 1 across 30-31 August. The Oman League Association's June 2026 calendar had announced a 27 August start, which the opener did not keep - the actual first match day was 30 August.

fields.quote: فسينطلق دوري جندال في 27 أغسطس من هذا العام وسينتهي في 31 مايو 2027
fields.note: Al-Watan (15 June 2026) reports the Oman League Association's season calendar: the Jindal League ends 31 May 2027, the association's whole competition year running 13 August 2026 - 31 May 2027. It is a scheduled finish, not a played one - the league was only at round 3 when it broke for the Gulf Cup - so medium confidence. No fixture list with the last round's day was reachable.
